files.role: Java dependency graph and compiler/lint/test configuration
files.decision: Read all 1872 lines in bounded chunks and parsed all XML nodes. Compiler Xlint/Werror, Surefire 120-second process and JUnit 10-second defaults, Spotless validate and SpotBugs verify are explicit. Hundreds of Maven plugin transitive pins and Java 27/Maven floors are Java-specific. Preserve Formal AI benchmark floors, audit coverage and native-main-only policy. POM version-reader/writer parent handling differs; no unexecuted version-writing defect is presented as reproduced.

Resolve plugin/test artifact scope in addition to source scanning; fail on HTTP errors, unexpected result counts and any unsuppressed vulnerability. Keep Formal AI Cargo audit and strict scoped exception validation. No live Maven audit was run.

Native CLI parsing rejects unknown/missing options. Preserve safe argument handling and consistent version writes. Java standalone regex handling differs from the hardened project-version reader; parent/comment cases remain source observations here.

Java intentionally warns for stale versions on every event and verifies integrity independently. Keep Formal AI strict findings/unverifiable policy. Java tests already cover stale-version/bad-pin integrity and do not reproduce the Go early-continue bypass.
Inspect actual tracked source and explicit large-file warnings. Keep Formal AI targets and account for unresolved warnings instead of raising limits or hiding files.
Reviewed option-injection, freshness and protected logging cases. Keep executable negative controls and safe argument boundaries; do not treat source regex coverage as hosted execution.

Protect contributor text when printed and keep fragment consumption tied to successful release writes. Java can ignore invalid fragments while removing input files; this is a source observation without a separate executed defect claim. Continuation 2026-11-22: the unchanged complete collector CLI now reproduces deletion of CRLF, malformed and empty inputs without their notes. Disposable candidate copies retain valid LF/CRLF notes and preserve every input plus the changelog when any fragment is invalid; mixed good/bad batches are covered. See java-boundary-controls-20261122.md.

Use strict safe version arguments, distinguish exists/missing/unknown, require the remote tag and verify publication artifacts in the workflow. Keep Formal AI verified receipts, source freshness and default-branch writer restrictions.
Use native argument parsing and structured output rather than direct dispatch interpolation. Keep Formal AI changelog.d format and existing version trigger.

Unmodified detector turns failed comparisons into successful negative outputs; already reproduced and reported as Java #30. Formal AI propagates unknown comparisons and permits a tree fallback only for established initial commits. Native execution remains main-only and unverified here.

Fresh 128-bit stop/resume command tokens protect contributor text. Formal AI cache diagnostics now use the same boundary with bounded retained bytes/lines and URL redaction. A human prefix alone is not a runner-command boundary.

Only the exact not-found result is missing; authentication/network/rate-limit/server/unavailable-tool results are unknown. Default diagnostics stay quiet; verbose text suspends workflow commands. Preserve independent verified/failed/unknown receipts.
Preserve bump priority, release note fidelity and safe logging. Java package frontmatter is not the Formal AI changelog format; source review is not a claim of full upstream suite execution.

No runner plus no steps plus the exact acquisition annotation is required; unknown annotations remain unclassified. Paginate jobs/annotations and allow only two automatic retries. Do not classify cache/backend failures by counters alone.

The repaired Java fallback validates all changesets when the base diff is unavailable. Its absent-changeset warning is an explicit weaker policy. Keep Formal AI required fragments and distinguish unavailable observations from empty diffs.

New real-Git regression proves failed commit still yields released=true and pushes an old-source tag in both modes. Candidate removal of the commit-error fallback blocks tags/pushes, with positive controls. Formal AI already exits on failed commit and tags after a successful source push; retain those stronger checks. Java report pending immutable evidence publication; no upstream repair is claimed.
Tests pin runner/tool/download/input/publication policy, but text assertions do not execute the dependency graph. Keep Formal AI behavior controls and main-only native scope.
